body: 2. **Moderate** — The coachman's exit-2 instruction (`coachman.md:1011-1015`) reads as unactionable: exit 2 means held for the user's approval, and every comment already has a reason at exit 2, so "give each comment its reason" can't change the result. A literal agent could loop instead of proceeding to paste the section. Needs rewording: exit 2 = proceed and paste; the fix instruction applies to exits 3/4.
